metadata.name: Harvest
metadata.description: Connect Harvest time tracking: list clients and projects, and read or log time entries from agent chat.

secrets.label: Harvest OAuth client id
secrets.description: Publisher-provided OAuth client id for the Harvest developer app (id.getharvest.com).

secrets.label: Harvest OAuth client secret
secrets.description: Publisher-provided OAuth client secret for the Harvest developer app (id.getharvest.com).

migrations.description: Initial schema: settings + secrets key-value tables.

tools.name: harvest
tools.description: Harvest time tracking. Actions: list_clients, list_projects (optionally by client_id), list_task_assignments (billable tasks of a project; needed before creating a time entry), list_time_entries (filter by project_id/client_id/user_id/from/to dates), create_time_entry (project_id + task_id + spent_date, optional hours + notes; omit hours to start a running timer), connection_status.

client_id.description: Harvest client id. Filter for list_projects / list_time_entries.

project_id.description: Harvest project id. Required for list_task_assignments and create_time_entry; filter for list_time_entries.

task_id.description: Harvest task id (from list_task_assignments). Required for create_time_entry.

user_id.description: Filter list_time_entries to one Harvest user.

is_active.description: Filter list_clients / list_projects by active state.

from.description: list_time_entries: only entries on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: list_time_entries: only entries on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

spent_date.description: create_time_entry: the date the time was spent (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.

hours.description: create_time_entry: decimal hours (e.g. 1.5). Omit to start a running timer instead.

notes.description: create_time_entry: free-text notes on the entry.

page.description: Page number for list actions (Harvest pages from 1).

tools.name: harvest_oauth_callback
tools.description: Dispatched by the publisher-shared OAuth bouncer after Harvest redirects with a code. Exchanges the code and persists tokens to per-install D1.

tools.name: refresh_harvest_tokens
tools.description: Scheduled keep-warm refresh of the stored Harvest OAuth tokens. Not intended for direct agent use.
